# convoy_project (Resource)

A Convoy project is an isolated workspace holding endpoints, sources, subscriptions and events. `outgoing` projects send webhooks to your customers; `incoming` projects receive webhooks from providers. Managing projects requires a personal API key (project API keys cannot create projects).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a personal API key and the organisation ID
# (provider "organisation_id" or CONVOY_ORGANISATION_ID).
resource "convoy_project" "billing" {
  name = "billing"
  type = "outgoing"

  config = {
    disable_endpoint = true

    strategy = {
      type        = "exponential"
      duration    = 10
      retry_count = 8
    }

    signature = {
      header = "X-Convoy-Signature"
      versions = [
        { hash = "SHA256", encoding = "hex" },
      ]
    }

    meta_event = {
      is_enabled = true
      type       = "http"
      url        = "https://ops.example.com/convoy-meta"
      event_type = ["endpoint.created", "endpoint.disabled", "eventdelivery.failed"]
    }
  }
}

# The project API key is only returned at creation time.
output "billing_api_key" {
  value     = convoy_project.billing.api_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.
- `type` (String) Project type, `outgoing` or `incoming`. Changing this forces a new project.

### Optional

- `config` (Attributes) Project configuration. Omitted settings keep Convoy's current (default) values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the project logo.
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation that owns the project. Defaults to the provider's `organisation_id`. Changing this forces a new project.

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Project API key generated when the project is created. Only returned at creation; empty for imported projects.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (`uid`) of the project.

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `add_event_id_trace_headers` (Boolean) Add event ID and event delivery ID headers to dispatched requests.
- `circuit_breaker` (Attributes) Circuit breaker that disables endpoints that keep failing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--circuit_breaker))
- `disable_endpoint` (Boolean) Disable endpoints once the retry threshold of an event is reached.
- `max_payload_read_size` (Number) Maximum number of bytes read from an ingested or sent payload.
- `meta_event` (Attributes) Meta events: Convoy sends notifications about the project's own activity (endpoint changes, delivery outcomes...). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--meta_event))
- `multiple_endpoint_subscriptions` (Boolean) Allow several subscriptions per endpoint.
- `ratelimit` (Attributes) Project wide rate limiting. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--ratelimit))
- `replay_attacks_prevention_enabled` (Boolean) Add a timestamp to the signature header to prevent replay attacks.
- `search_policy` (String) Go duration (e.g. `720h`) of event retention for search.
- `signature` (Attributes) Signature header and versions used to sign outgoing webhooks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--signature))
- `ssl` (Attributes) Endpoint SSL enforcement rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--ssl))
- `strategy` (Attributes) Retry strategy for failing deliveries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--strategy))

<a id="nestedatt--config--circuit_breaker"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.circuit_breaker`

Optional:

- `consecutive_failure_threshold` (Number) Consecutive trips after which the endpoint is disabled.
- `error_timeout` (Number) Seconds a tripped breaker stays open.
- `failure_threshold` (Number) Failure percentage that trips the breaker.
- `minimum_request_count` (Number) Minimum requests in the window before the breaker can trip.
- `observability_window` (Number) Window, in minutes, over which failures are counted.
- `sample_rate` (Number) How often (seconds) the breaker samples delivery results.
- `success_threshold` (Number) Success percentage needed to close a half-open breaker.


<a id="nestedatt--config--meta_event"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.meta_event`

Optional:

- `event_type` (List of String) Meta event types to send, e.g. `endpoint.created`, `eventdelivery.success`.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether meta events are enabled.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret used to sign meta events.
- `type` (String) Delivery type, `http`.
- `url` (String) URL meta events are delivered to.


<a id="nestedatt--config--ratelimit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.ratelimit`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Number of requests allowed per `duration`.
- `duration` (Number) Rate limit window, in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--config--signature"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.signature`

Optional:

- `header` (String) Signature header name, e.g. `X-Convoy-Signature`.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Signature versions, oldest first. Convoy signs with every version listed. Existing versions keep their identity when they stay at the same position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--signature--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--config--signature--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.signature.versions`

Required:

- `encoding` (String) Signature encoding, `hex` or `base64`.
- `hash` (String) Hash function, e.g. `SHA256` or `SHA512`.



<a id="nestedatt--config--ssl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.ssl`

Optional:

- `enforce_secure_endpoints` (Boolean) Only allow `https` endpoint URLs.


<a id="nestedatt--config--strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.strategy`

Optional:

- `duration` (Number) Seconds between retries (base interval for `exponential`).
- `retry_count` (Number) Maximum number of retries.
- `type` (String) Retry strategy, either `linear` or `exponential`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Projects are imported by ID. The api_key attribute stays empty.
terraform import convoy_project.billing 01H0JA5MEES38RRK3HTEJC647K
```
